news.label: Qwen4-Max Is Released
details: It's a multimodal model that can handle images, with a focus on tool calling and carrying out complex tasks.
That makes it easier for AI agents to work with long codebases and documents that include images.
It's different from open weight models that you can run locally.

lines.say: Let's start with Alibaba, which has launched its new flagship model, Qwen four Max.
lines.show: Let's start with Alibaba, which has launched its new flagship model, Qwen4-Max.

lines.say: It supports a context of one million tokens, and it can work with images too.
lines.show: It supports a one million token context, and it can work with images too.

lines.say: But it's an A P I model, not one you can run locally.
lines.show: But it's an API model, not one you can run locally.

link.title: Qwen
link.description: Qwen offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool utilization, and artifacts.

news.label: Long Videos from Voice and Image
details: It improves lip sync with audio and keeps the person looking consistent over long videos.
Model weights and inference code are publicly available.
Running it locally is a high bar.

lines.say: Next up is LongCat Video Avatar version one point six from Meituan.
lines.show: Next up is LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.6 from Meituan.

lines.say: From a voice recording and an image, it can create talking videos of a person lasting over ten minutes.
lines.show: From a voice recording and an image, it can create talking videos over ten minutes long.

lines.say: The weights are out under the M I T license, but you'll need multiple G P Us to run it.
lines.show: The weights are out under the MIT license, but you'll need multiple GPUs to run it.

news.label: Hugging Face Teams Up with OpenRouter
points: Retries with another provider on outages
details: It picks an inference provider based on price, speed, and reliability.
You can use multiple inference setups while keeping changes to your existing code small.
Supported open weight models can be called with your existing Hugging Face token.

lines.say: Now one for developers: Hugging Face has teamed up with OpenRouter.
lines.show: Now one for developers: Hugging Face has teamed up with OpenRouter.

lines.say: It automatically picks where to run your request based on price and speed, and switches to another provider if one goes down.
lines.show: It automatically picks where to run your request based on price and speed, and switches providers if one goes down.

link.title: Hugging Face and OpenRouter join forces to make open-weight models easy to run
link.description: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

news.label: Siemens AI Designs Robot Grippers
points: Full workflow not yet a product
details: You specify the object to grip and the task, and the AI operates Designcenter through M C P.
It moves on to shape changes, simulation, robot connection checks, and preparing data for additive manufacturing.
Siemens also envisions adaptive production cells, but the full workflow isn't available as a general product yet.

lines.say: And now our top story: AI-powered design from Siemens.
lines.show: And now our top story: AI-powered design from Siemens.

lines.say: Just describe what you need in text, and it designs a robot gripper, then carries on from simulation to preparing data for three D printing.
lines.show: Just describe what you need in text, and it designs a robot gripper, then goes from simulation to preparing data for 3D printing.

lines.say: That said, not all of it is available as a product yet.
lines.show: That said, not all of it is available as a product yet.

news.label: AI Links Cameras and Robots
points: Camera footage analyzed by a VLM
details: They confirmed the technical feasibility of an LLM giving work instructions to the JILBY cleaning robot.
They also tested JILBY and the ugo Nova humanoid sharing information and dividing up roles.

lines.say: Finally, a trial from Japan by Iris Ohyama and NTT West.
